# The Hacker News

> > Leading cybersecurity news source covering threat intelligence, vulnerability disclosures, malware analysis, and enterprise security strategies.

The Hacker News provides breaking news on critical vulnerabilities, APT campaigns, ransomware operations, and emerging security technologies. Coverage includes detailed technical analysis of exploits targeting enterprise platforms like SolarWinds, Cisco, Palo Alto, and ServiceNow, with focus on threat actors from Russia, China, and cybercriminal networks.

## Key Topics

- Remote Code Execution (RCE)
- Active Exploitation & Zero-Days
- APT Groups & Cyber Espionage
- Ransomware Operations
- Malware Analysis (ClickFix, PowerShell, DLL Sideloading)
- MFA Bypass & Phishing Campaigns
- Enterprise Security Patches (SolarWinds, Cisco, Palo Alto)
- Threat Intelligence
- Post-Quantum Cryptography
- AI Security & Non-Human Identities
- Open Source Supply Chain Security
- Botnet Disruption
- Nation-State Actors (Russia, China, Ukraine)
- Windows Security

## Critical Vulnerabilities & Active Exploitation

- [Cisco Confirms Active Exploitation of Two Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Vulnerabilities](https://thehackernews.com/2026/03/cisco-confirms-active-exploitation-of.html): Cisco warns CVE-2026-20122 & CVE-2026-20128 actively exploited in SD-WAN
- [SolarWinds Patches 4 Critical Serv-U 15.5 Flaws Allowing Root Code Execution](https://thehackernews.com/2026/02/solarwinds-patches-4-critical-serv-u.html): SolarWinds fixes 4 critical CVE-2025-40538 flaws in Serv-U 15.5
- [ServiceNow Patches Critical AI Platform Flaw Allowing Unauthenticated User Impersonation](https://thehackernews.com/2026/01/servicenow-patches-critical-ai-platform.html): ServiceNow fixes CVE-2025-12420 BodySnatcher user impersonation flaw
- [Palo Alto Fixes GlobalProtect DoS Flaw That Can Crash Firewalls Without Login](https://thehackernews.com/2026/01/palo-alto-fixes-globalprotect-dos-flaw.html): Palo Alto patches CVE-2026-0227 GlobalProtect DoS vulnerability
- [CISA Adds Actively Exploited Sierra Wireless Router Flaw Enabling RCE Attacks](https://thehackernews.com/2025/12/cisa-adds-actively-exploited-sierra.html): CISA warns CVE-2018-4063 Sierra Wireless AirLink ALEOS actively exploited
